# Book of Giants Fragment 10 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA (Arbiter) | **Source:** 4Q531 frag. 2 (Cave 4) | **Condition:** fragmentary; lamentation preserved in part

---

**10:1** [...] Woe to us [...] for our sin [...]

**10:2** [...] the judgment is sealed [...] and written in heaven [...]

**10:3** [...] and there is none who can erase it [...]

**10:4** [...] for the decree of the Most High stands [...]

**10:5** [...] and it cannot be turned back [...]

**10:6** [...] and there is no escape for us [...] neither in heaven above [...]

**10:7** [...] nor in the earth below [...]

**10:8** [...] for all the ways are closed before us [...]

**10:9** [...] and the gates of mercy are shut [...]

**10:10** [...] against our faces [...]

**10:11** [...] our mighty deeds are ended [...] and our power has been brought low [...]

**10:12** [...] and our glory has departed from us [...]

**10:13** [...] the strength of our arms is broken [...]

**10:14** [...] and we cannot stand before the judgment [...]

**10:15** [...] for our sins are too great [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Fragment 10 (Lament of the Giants). Source: 4Q531 frag. 2. The SOPHIA consensus translation adjudicates between EMET (literal), LOGOS (formal), and PNEUMA (dynamic) renderings. Priority is given to accuracy, preserving established biblical idiom, and maintaining the theological register of the Enochic literature. All disagreements are logged separately. Square brackets indicate genuine manuscript lacunae.*
